notes: Year 1 book-to-tax: 400,000 pretax - 3,000 muni interest (permanent) - 60,000 prepaid insurance deducted for tax when paid + 48,000 warranty accrued for books but not yet paid = 385,000 taxable. The prepaid insurance is a taxable temporary difference (asset book basis 60,000 > tax basis 0) so it creates the DTL and fully reverses in Year 2; the warranty is a deductible temporary difference that reverses 16,000 per year in Years 2-4, so a 3,360 DTA still remains at December 31 Year 3 for the Year 4 settlement.
